name: Home Depot Plaza – Copiague
summary: Home Depot Plaza is a fully-leased 135,436 square foot community center anchored by The Home Depot on high-traffic Sunrise Highway in Copiague, NY. The center serves an affluent Long Island trade area with median household incomes exceeding $130,000 within 3 miles.
demographics: Home Depot Plaza serves a predominantly middle to upper-middle class suburban market in Copiague, NY, with the 3-mile trade area showing a median household income of $130,578 and average household income of $157,034. The center attracts families and homeowners from the surrounding Long Island communities, with a population of over 155,000 within 3 miles, who visit for home improvement needs, everyday shopping, and services. The demographic profile skews toward established households with strong purchasing power, as evidenced by the per capita income of $52,715 in the 3-mile radius, making it an attractive location for retailers serving home-focused consumers.
description: Home Depot Plaza is a well-positioned community shopping center strategically located on Sunrise Highway (Route 27) in Copiague, New York, benefiting from high daily traffic volumes along this major Long Island thoroughfare. Anchored by The Home Depot, this 135,436 square foot center has established itself as a successful retail destination through strong anchor performance and highly visible outparcel buildings that maximize exposure to passing motorists. The center serves a prosperous trade area with a median household income exceeding $130,000 within 3 miles, drawing from a population base of over 155,000 residents in the surrounding communities. With a parking ratio of 10.34 spaces per 1,000 square feet, the plaza offers ample convenient parking for shoppers visiting the various retailers and service providers. Currently fully leased, Home Depot Plaza demonstrates consistent tenant demand and operational success in the competitive New York-Newark-Jersey City metropolitan market.
